mostWorthwhile.text: Building the pulling proteins was most worthwhile: the picture showed how overlapping fibres can slide to shorten a cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: The supporting-cell path repeated the same messenger-then-amino-acid pattern, so it felt less interesting even though the comparison was useful.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the same DNA and building blocks to lead to proteins kept inside one kind of cell and fibres released around another.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly purposeless, although I followed the named messenger pairings without understanding exactly how the signals activate genes.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter to see how these separate muscle cells become larger fibres, though I hope it offers more than the repeated two-step pattern.
